method.name: actual_labs_vector_index_text_only_vs_hybrid_search_quality_eval_v1
method.description: Reads the applied labs JSONL vector index, verifies vector records against planned upsert records, runs deterministic lookup probes, and compares text-only layout retrieval with a hybrid that can also retrieve labs vector records.
limitations: This does not query the production vector DB or operational search route.
Queries are deterministic probes derived from retrieval-hint text, not live user traffic.
A passing result authorizes only production vector DB integration design, not production indexing.

productValidation.productQuestion: Do the 125 applied visual retrieval hints improve search candidate discovery enough to design production vector DB integration?
productValidation.userScenario: A paper search should find visually described figures, tables, equations, and layout regions that text-only layout context often misses.
